verdict.rationale: OneDrive's own first-party docs describe a public REST API through Microsoft Graph. It covers item addressing, uploads (including resumable sessions), search, sharing links, delta change tracking, change notifications and versions. It also comes with a machine-readable $metadata document, Graph Explorer, a developer sandbox and a published versioning/deprecation policy. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the metadata is CSDL/EDMX shared across all of Graph. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use, OpenAPI-format machine-readable spec.
